summary: A large, multi-story wooden facility resembling a prison or fortress. It features a complex, roughly I-shaped footprint with a central corridor, asymmetrical wings, and two tall watchtowers. The structure is characterized by wood plank walls, horizontal stone brick bands separating the three main floors, and flat roofs bordered by stone.

shape.overall_form: Central spine with asymmetrical wings and flanking watchtowers

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: floor dividers, roof edging, and perimeter wall

materials.name: brick
materials.role: roof surface (appears to be dark/nether brick)

rebuild_hints: Lay out the complex footprint first: a long central spine with a T-junction at one end and an offset L-shape at the other.
Construct the main building up to 3 floors, using wood planks for walls and separating each floor with a protruding band of stone bricks.
Erect the two tall watchtowers on either side of the central spine, using wood logs for the corner pillars.
Cap the roofs flatly using a dark material (like nether brick) bordered by stone bricks, and place a light source (glowstone) in the center of the tower roofs.
Surround the base with a low, spaced-out stone brick perimeter wall.
uncertainties: Exact dimensions and block counts are estimated from aerial views and may be slightly off.
Interior layout, staircases, and floor plans are completely invisible.
The specific type of dark brick used for the roof surface (likely nether brick) is not definitively identifiable.
